1.11.4

Kills the stale-module trap at the source. Until now only `main.js` carried a `?v=` cache-buster; every nested import (`./app.js`, `./views/*.js`, `./lib/*.js`, vendor Preact) resolved to a bare URL, so a browser or host cache could keep serving the previous release's module bodies after an update — the state the gear menu reports as `v → v · RELOAD`. The page shell now builds its import map server-side from every file under `app/src/**/*.js` (plus the three vendor modules), mapping each module's absolute URL to its `?v=` twin; import maps match on the resolved URL, so every nested import is rewritten to a brand-new URL per release and no URL-keyed cache can hand back old code. The stale chip is also a real button now: tapping it unregisters the service worker, deletes every app cache and reloads — a hard reload you can reach from the iPhone home-screen app, where Cmd+Shift+R doesn't exist. One last manual hard reload is needed to pick up this build; after that, updates land on a plain reload.
